Game Overview

T-Rex Running Color puts players into a dinosaur experience centered on guide a spunky T-Rex through a vibrant, ever-accelerating world. Leap over cacti and dodge devious pterodactyls in this thrilling race against time. Sharpen your reflexes as the speed escalates, pushing your skills to new limits while aiming for record-breaking distances.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in T-Rex Running Color is easy to pick up. Guide a spunky T-Rex through a vibrant, ever-accelerating world.
